_description: Datasheet for Snap Circuits Jr. components used in the simulated circuit.

U1.description: Snap Circuits Music IC that generates a signal for the Happy Birthday song
U1.notes: U1 is a Music IC used for various Snap Circuits Jr. projects.

S1.notes: S1 is a simple slide switch used to control circuit power.

SP.notes: SP is an 8-ohm speaker used for audio output in Snap Circuits Jr. projects.

B1.description: Snap Circuits battery holder for 2 AA batteries
B1.notes: B1 provides 3V DC power from two AA batteries.
